input.quote: This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions
input.rationale: Renewal terms are 12 months (acceptable), but the only means of avoiding a renewal is the 90 days' written notice in Section 4(a), which exceeds our fallback window of 60 days. We reduced Customer's non-renewal/exit notice to 30 days and left Kubient's at 90 days. No price-uplift cap is needed here as compensation is a revenue share, so that sub-element is noted only.
